keyEvents.text: Goal! Anderlecht 1, Salzburg 0. Ludwig Augustinsson (Anderlecht) from a free kick with a left footed shot to the top left corner.
Mario Stroeykens (Anderlecht) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Edmund Baidoo (Salzburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Haris Tabakovic (Salzburg) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
